candidates.hypothesis: Across the frozen month-start decisions, ranking all Massive as-of active common stocks with the already fixed broad-market continuation policy, without present-day or legacy-core priority, produces after-cost 20-session replacement value above the same-date cash-feasible core candidate when one exists and cash otherwise because date-native membership exposes liquid continuation leaders omitted by core/current-roster history.

provenance.baseline_policy: same-decision-date cash-feasible core candidate if present, otherwise cash

independent_evidence.decision_exclusions: descriptive fields, FIGIs, current reference rows and future vendor revisions

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The cash-feasible core-or-cash prior prices the best currently admitted opportunity as the slot hurdle, while the independent dated Massive surface may reveal a stronger continuation candidate that a core/current-roster history cannot represent without survivorship leakage.

transmission.expected_direction: The selected full-market candidate should exceed the return of the displaced core candidate or cash over the identical costed holding interval.
transmission.catalyst: Persistent relative strength, 60-session trend, proximity to the 60-session high and non-declining participation known at the month-start decision close.
transmission.half_life: Next eligible session open through the twentieth subsequent trading session.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The rule buys public price continuation after it is visible, pays round-trip costs, competes for a scarce cash-funded slot and spans smaller names whose reversals, gaps and concentration can erase the apparent cross-sectional advantage.
candidates.falsifier: Reject unless every standard window has at least five selected touches and strictly positive after-cost replacement value, aggregate replacement value is strictly positive, the double-cost aggregate remains positive, the maximum single-ticker positive contribution is at most 50%, the top-five share is at most 60%, contribution HHI is at most 0.35, and all source, identity, split and decision-clock checks pass.

baseline.policy: At each frozen Massive decision date, use the same-date cash-feasible core selected candidate if the frozen core policy admits one; otherwise retain cash for the identical horizon.

treatment.policy: At each of the 19 frozen date-native membership snapshots, select up to three candidates using broad_market_price_floor_rank_low_extension_high_volatility_trend_persistence_v1 and DEFAULT_CONFIG, with no current or legacy core-membership input; enter next session open, exit after 20 sessions, and apply the existing rank and feature notional profile plus round-trip costs.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: The same-date cash-feasible core candidate's identical next-open-to-20-session costed value when present, otherwise zero-return cash; SPY and QQQ are reported separately and never replace the primary comparator.

execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Cash equities exactly as identified by the Massive decision-date ticker; no ETF, option, leverage or present-day identity mapping.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Decision close must be at least $40 and the frozen 20-day volume-ratio rule must pass; research entry requires a valid next-session open.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Use the repository round-trip cost percentage and a predeclared double-cost stress; no financing credit is assumed.
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; the treatment is long-only and cannot create a short.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most three selections per decision, existing broad-market rank/feature notional multipliers, and no claim beyond research slot replacement.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Membership and all features must be known at the decision close; entry is the next eligible session open and exit is the fixed twentieth-session close with split-local normalization.

candidates.title: Massive date-native full-market continuation opportunity cost

prediction.confidence_reason: The new source removes the former survivorship blocker and all windows clear outcome-blind touch density, but the treatment is public continuation after price discovery, competes with the accepted core hurdle and remains vulnerable to smaller-name reversals and concentration.

candidates.reopen_condition: If rejected, do not retune the same thresholds, top-N, notional profile or hold. Reopen only with canonical Massive vintages, a genuinely independent non-price evidence source, or materially settled forward rows under this unchanged policy.
candidates.next_machine_action: Complete model-diverse challenge and verification; if the final panel remains pass, reserve exactly one private_replay_scout with result ceiling observed_only and no paper/live changes.
